title: Heavy rains forecast across Jonglei; Bor–Pibor road expected to become impassable
body: Seasonal forecasts indicate above-average rainfall over Jonglei in the coming week. Transporters expect the Bor–Pibor and Pibor–Akobo tracks to become impassable for trucks, and standing water is already reported on sections of the Juba–Bor road near Bor.

title: Clashes reported near Nasir along the Sobat corridor; convoys paused
body: Fighting was reported around Nasir town on the Sobat river. River convoys between Malakal and Nasir have been paused and road movements between Ulang and Nasir are suspended until further notice.

title: Truck overturned on Juba–Nimule highway
body: A cargo truck overturned on the Juba–Nimule highway about 40 km north of Nimule, blocking one lane. Traffic is moving slowly; clearance expected within 24 hours.

title: Fuel shortage in Wau pushes up trucking rates
body: Fuel stations in Wau report shortages. Local transporters are quoting higher rates for routes out of Wau towards Aweil and Kuajok.

title: Tensions rise around Leer; checkpoints may close the Rumbek–Leer road
body: Local authorities warn of possible checkpoint closures on the Rumbek–Leer road following tensions between communities around Leer. Movements may be restricted at short notice.
